Package index

Package overview

Overview of the MultiStateTMLE package.

MultiStateTMLE MultiStateTMLE-package
MultiStateTMLE: Causal Inference for Multistate Event Processes via TMLE

Initial fit

Fitting the initial (nuisance) hazard models and building the discrete product state space used internally.

fit_initial()
Fit the initial hazard models

Targeted estimation

Targeting the initial fit under a stochastic intensity intervention.

tmle_alpha()
Targeted estimation under a stochastic intensity intervention
estimate_derivative()
Estimate the derivative of an estimate with respect to alpha

Calibration

Calibrating an intensity intervention to a target effect size, and decomposing treatment effects into calibrated contrasts.

calibrate_alpha()
Calibrate an intensity intervention to a target value
calibration_curve()
Trace the calibration curve over a grid of interventions
solve_alpha()
Solve for the intervention achieving a target value
calibrated_contrasts()
Decompose a treatment effect into mediated and calibrated contrasts

Data

Example data.

illness_death
Simulated illness-death data
